title: Recommended Textbooks
description: Core textbooks for Probability, Statistics, and Discrete Mathematics.

children.title: Probability and Statistics for Engineering
children.description: Jay L. Devore - The standard textbook for engineering statistics.

children.title: A First Course in Probability
children.description: Sheldon Ross - Excellent for deep theoretical understanding of probability.

children.title: Probability & Statistics for Engineers
children.description: Walpole, Myers, Myers, Ye - Great for practical applications and regression.

children.title: Discrete Mathematics and Its Applications
children.description: Kenneth Rosen - The definitive guide for counting, permutations, and combinations.

children.title: Introduction to Linear Regression Analysis
children.description: Montgomery, Peck, Vining - Deep dive into the regression analysis portion of the syllabus.

title: Video Lectures & Playlists
description: Curated YouTube channels and playlists for mastering statistics and probability.

children.title: StatQuest with Josh Starmer
children.description: The absolute best channel for intuitive explanations of stats, distributions, and regression.

children.title: ZedStatistics
children.description: Clear, concise, and well-animated videos on probability and distributions.

children.title: Khan Academy: Statistics & Probability
children.description: Comprehensive, step-by-step foundational video lessons.

children.title: jbstatistics
children.description: Great for specific distribution derivations (Poisson, Binomial, Hypergeometric).

children.title: MIT 18.05 - Intro to Probability & Statistics
children.description: Complete semester course from MIT with lecture notes and exams.

children.title: Trevor F. Miller - Regression & ANOVA
children.description: Excellent walkthroughs for linear regression and hypothesis testing.

title: Practice Platforms & Problems
description: Interactive platforms to test your probability and statistics skills.

children.title: Brilliant.org - Probability & Statistics
children.description: Interactive, visual problem-solving for probability intuition and distributions.

children.title: Khan Academy Exercises
children.description: Free, auto-graded practice problems for every stats topic.

children.title: Statistics How To
children.description: Massive library of step-by-step solved statistics problems and calculator guides.

children.title: Varsity Tutors - Probability
children.description: Quick practice questions for basic probability and counting.

title: Interactive Visualizations
description: Visualize distributions, regression, and probability concepts in action.

children.title: Seeing Theory (Brown University)
children.description: A visual introduction to probability and statistics. Absolutely stunning interactive demos.

children.title: Setosa Explained Visually
children.description: Interactive visualizations for Ordinary Least Squares Regression, Markov Chains, and Conditional Probability.

children.title: Rossman/Chance Applets
children.description: Academic-grade simulation applets for distributions, sampling, and regression.

children.title: GeoGebra Probability & Stats
children.description: Interactive calculators for Normal, Binomial, Poisson, and other distributions.

title: Calculators & Software Tools
description: Essential tools, tables, and software for statistical analysis.

children.title: Casio fx-991EX Calculator Guide
children.description: How to use STAT mode for regression, mean, variance, and distributions.

children.title: Standard Normal (Z) Table
children.description: High-res, printable Z-table for Normal distribution problems.

children.title: Python SciPy Stats Documentation
children.description: Python library for calculating PDFs, CDFs, and running regression.

children.title: R Project for Statistical Computing
children.description: The industry-standard free software for heavy statistical analysis.

children.title: Overleaf (LaTeX Editor)
children.description: Essential for typing up complex mathematical formulas and proofs cleanly.

title: Community & Study Strategy
description: Forums, cheat sheets, and study resources.

children.title: Cross Validated (Stack Exchange)
children.description: The premier Q&A site for statistics, machine learning, and data analysis.

children.title: Math Stack Exchange - Probability
children.description: Q&A for theoretical probability and combinatorics.

children.title: Reddit r/statistics
children.description: Community discussion for statistics concepts and software.

children.title: Probability & Statistics Cheat Sheets
children.description: Quick reference guides for distributions, expected values, and variances.
